paragraphs: Catch breaking changes in AI vendor APIs before your code does.

ModelPulse watches 15 public AI vendor changelog pages daily, normalizes them into a single schema, and alerts you on Slack/Discord the moment a breaking change ships. When a vendor redesigns their page, the pipeline auto-heals itself — no code change, no redeployment. Built for the Scrape-Verse Hackathon with Bright Data Scraper Studio.
Because subscribing isn't the problem — normalizing, scoring, and acting is. The 15-second answer:
features: Half these vendors have no feed at all. Mistral, Cohere, Groq, Together, Fireworks, Replicate publish changelogs as plain HTML pages. There is nothing to subscribe to.

Even where feeds exist, they're unstructured marketing prose. No changetype, no breaking flag, no version. ModelPulse normalizes every vendor into one schema (added/changed/deprecated/removed/fixed + a 0–100 impact…
Feeds only tell you what's new — never what was edited. Vendors silently rewrite published entries. ModelPulse diffs every field on every scrape and flags silent edits (the ↻ EDITED badge).
CORS is enabled — call it from anywhere.
